about: Look test 2026-11-08: Zei and Bai, 12 changes x 2 closing lines, FLUX (as the route sends: the front only), FLUX with three sheet views (Zei only), Qwen, GPT, Gemini. Drafted by the coding agent (Claude, a closed model by Anthropic). DRAFT. Test pictures only: nothing published, no database.

style.label: Mood
style.text: Intense, highly detailed graphic novel look. Moody. Expressive. Dark lines, bold colors. Visible brushstrokes.
style.why: The remix screen starts on the picture's own style when it is listed, else the first listed (makeView). The bases' style, "Animated series", is not published, and there are no presets yet, so the first listed is the newest published style: Mood.

lines.A: Keep the same character: face, hair, build and clothes, unless the change says otherwise.
lines.B: Keep the face recognisable; change anything else the words describe.
